1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000020_ELIDIBUS
1.description: Why am I...? Was it you who called me here?

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000030_LAHABREA
2.description: (-Convocation Speaker-)<hex:024804F2022303>On behalf of the Convocation, I bid you welcome to our order.<hex:0248020103>

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000040_LAHABREA
3.description: (-Convocation Speaker-)<hex:024804F2022303>At times you will stand with us. At times you will stand against us. All that you might steer mankind and the very star upon their true course.<hex:0248020103>

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000050_LAHABREA
4.description: (-Convocation Speaker-)<hex:024804F2022303>For yours is the seat of Elidibus, the emissary, and by this name shall your every action be guided.<hex:0248020103>

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000060_ELIDIBUS
5.description: So you peered into my memories... No matter. You will have found little of import.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000070_ELIDIBUS
6.description: But I see you intended to summon me here no more than I intended to come. The fault is mine.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000080_ELIDIBUS
7.description: Such is the burden of hope...

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
10.description: Why must you embroil the people in your plans?

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000090_ELIDIBUS
12.description: What fool would relinquish his weapon on the eve of battle?

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000100_ELIDIBUS
13.description: I merely avail myself of such tools as I require for the conflict to come.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000110_ELIDIBUS
14.description: Come now, my plans are no mystery.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000120_ELIDIBUS
15.description: That which I do is no different from that which you have done so many times, Warrior of Darkness.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000130_ELIDIBUS
16.description: I arm myself. I hone my skills. I make ready to vanquish my enemy─you.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000140_ELIDIBUS
17.description: You who have murdered my brothers─who have taken their selfless labors in service to the one true world and turned them to ash.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000150_ELIDIBUS
18.description: I see you for what you are. You are death, and only in death shall you serve any purpose.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000160_ELIDIBUS
19.description: The Convocation charged me to steer mankind and the very star upon their true course. As Elidibus, it is my duty. And I shall see it done.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000180_ELIDIBUS
21.description: Destroy you body and soul. All else must wait.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000190_DUMMYARDBERT
22.description: Destroy you body and soul. All else must wait.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000200_ELIDIBUS
23.description: Ere long I will come for you, Warrior of Darkness. And I will save the world.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000220_ELIDIBUS
25.description: I bore witness to your final struggle with Emet-Selch. It seemed as if he saw something familiar in you.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000230_ELIDIBUS
26.description: As if he mistook you for another.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
28.description: Hythlodaeus called me his “new old friend.”

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000240_ELIDIBUS
30.description: ...No. I recall not of whom he spoke.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000250_ELIDIBUS
31.description: Keep your counsel, then. You spare me further frustration. As often as we have met, you have never once awakened any memory within me.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000260_ELIDIBUS
32.description: Mayhap I never knew you. Or mayhap it is another fragment lost.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000270_MYSTERYVOICE
33.description: (-???-)Ah, I wasn't aware you already had a guest. If the conversation is constructive, I shall not intrude.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000280_MYSTERYVOICE
34.description: But if you seek to stir up trouble, Elidibus, then I must insist you leave at once.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000300_ELIDIBUS
36.description: Though you lack Her blessing, your soul is surprisingly dense... Hmph.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000310_MYSTERYVOICE
37.description: Worry not, I seem to be unharmed.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000320_MYSTERYVOICE
38.description: Oh, this... This is my own doing─the consequence of my recent exertions.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000330_MYSTERYVOICE
39.description: It is the tower's way of compensating me for the demands I have placed on it.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000340_MYSTERYVOICE
40.description: Rest assured, it is no great inconvenience at present. Indeed, I told Beq Lugg as much...but they would not be persuaded, and sent me away to rest.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000350_MYSTERYVOICE
41.description: No need to make a fuss. Strange as it may sound, I consider it something of a badge of honor.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000360_MYSTERYVOICE
42.description: One of the brave souls who saw me delivered unto the First once said...

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000370_MYSTERYVOICE
43.description: That the world shall ever have a place for tales of heroism, so long as we have need of inspiration in our lives.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000380_MYSTERYVOICE
44.description: Though he and his fellows had no way of knowing whether their mad scheme would amount to anything, they knew that the attempt alone would inspire hope. Or so they hoped.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000390_MYSTERYVOICE
45.description: A more optimistic lot, one would be hard-pressed to find.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000400_MYSTERYVOICE
46.description: They said they would find a means to save our godsforsaken world─just as soon as they had sent me on my way. Said it with such confidence that, for a fleeting moment, I half believed them.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000410_MYSTERYVOICE
47.description: Such faith, such courage in the face of unrelenting despair. For a long time, it was more than I could bear to remember them.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000420_MYSTERYVOICE
48.description: But having come this far─having sent full many on their way myself─I see things more clearly.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000430_MYSTERYVOICE
49.description: To take action is to hope. To believe─to <hex:021A020203>choose<hex:021A020103> to believe is to take the first step towards a brighter future.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000440_MYSTERYVOICE
50.description: And why do I tell you this? Because I want you to indulge me in a little recklessness.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000450_MYSTERYVOICE
51.description: Needless to say, I have a plan. And...when all is said and done, I will ask yet another favor of you.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000530_KRILE
59.description: I would rather you hadn't seen this.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000540_TATARU
60.description: I'm sorry. We have urgent tidings...

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000550_KRILE
61.description: No, no, I'm not angry with you. On the contrary.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000560_KRILE
62.description: I know full well how hard everyone has been searching for a way to return home. And I had hoped to afford you the time you needed.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000570_KRILE
63.description: But given our friends' present state, perhaps it was for the best that you came.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000580_KRILE
64.description: Stiff and cold, all of them. As if they were made of wax.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000600_KRILE
66.description: And they had been doing so well. Save for occasional signs of aetheric instability, they appeared to be in passable health.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000610_KRILE
67.description: Then, quite without warning, things took a turn for the worse. A change for which even Master Matoya could offer no explanation.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000620_KRILE
68.description: She could only remind me that the soul is yet an unknown frontier, and that much and more lies beyond our ken.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000630_KRILE
69.description: But let's not lose heart just yet. At times like these, it is all the more important that we remain positive.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000640_KRILE
70.description: Why, I but this moment succeeded in quelling a fluctuation in Thancred's aether.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000650_KRILE
71.description: And while the others have weakened, they have remained relatively stable. I believe I may leave my post for a moment.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000660_KRILE
72.description: So come, let me hear your tale outside.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000680_THANCRED
74.description: We have visited every region and confirmed the presence of Ascians throughout the realm.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000690_URIANGER
75.description: Lest a grave predicament be made to seem hopeless, it should be noted that they are of inferior rank. The black-masked minions who answer to the red.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000700_THANCRED
76.description: Yes. A gaggle of schemers attempting to exploit recent events to sow the seeds of petty conflict.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000710_THANCRED
77.description: Fortunately, nothing of any great concern has come of their meddling just yet.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000720_ALISAIE
78.description: We also encountered a number of the Crystarium's former defenders, busily solving this problem and that in a bid to become Warriors of Light.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000730_MYSTERYVOICE
79.description: Their zeal is to be applauded. 'Tis but a pity I cannot encourage them on their course...

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000740_THANCRED
80.description: Not knowing Elidibus set them upon it, no. Both the troubles to be solved and the villains to be vanquished are his doing too, like as not.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000750_THANCRED
81.description: And so, with apologies to the aspiring Warriors of Light, I believe it best that we deal with the Ascians quickly and quietly.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000770_ALPHINAUD
83.description: But tell us, what news from the Source? How fare our bodies?

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
85.description: Uh...well enough─though time is not on our side.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
86.description: I'm sorry, but...things have taken a turn for the worse.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000780_ALPHINAUD
87.description: Indeed. Heartening though it is to know we can stay awhile longer, returning home must remain our priority.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000781_ALISAIE
88.description: This seems an appropriate moment to ask about the spirit vessel. Have you made any progress?

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000790_ALPHINAUD
89.description: ...Oh dear. Then we must redouble our efforts! Not that we have ever stinted in that regard...

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000800_ALISAIE
90.description: This would seem an appropriate moment to ask about the spirit vessel. Tell me you've made some progress.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000810_BEQLUGG
91.description: We have, as it happens. One moment.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000820_URIANGER
92.description: The red stones... Then this doth mean...

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000830_BEQLUGG
93.description: For the benefit of all, permit us to explain.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000840_BEQLUGG
94.description: As you will recall, using white auracite as our starting point, we fashioned a vessel for mind and memory both.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000850_BEQLUGG
95.description: Yet though it served this purpose admirably, the process of imbuing it with one's complete essence proved a somewhat thornier proposition.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000860_BEQLUGG
96.description: Simply put, the memory would not accompany the mind. And so we looked to the Allagans' mastery of memory transference for a solution.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000870_MYSTERYVOICE
97.description: This approach was not without its own complications, however, relying as it does upon blood─which inanimate objects notably do not possess.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000880_MYSTERYVOICE
98.description: We duly explored methods of suffusing the vessel with drops of the aforementioned. Alas, our painstaking experimentation succeeded only in making me feel faint, and singularly failed to imbue the crystal with the necessary properties.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000890_MYSTERYVOICE
99.description: It was then that an idea occurred to me: namely, that we might fuse the vessel not with normal blood, but with my crystallized essence.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000900_ALISAIE
100.description: You're doing this for our sakes, so far be it from us to complain...

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000910_ALISAIE
101.description: But don't think we haven't noticed what's happening to your arm.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000920_MYSTERYVOICE
102.description: It falls well short of offering up my life in exchange for yours─which was your only stipulated prohibition, as I recall. And it is but a small price to pay for delivering you home.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000940_BEQLUGG
104.description: We shall soon know if this grisly addition will serve as a suitable conduit for the subject's memory. Though...not soon enough to warrant your waiting. The test is like to take a while.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000950_THANCRED
105.description: Let us be off, then. We have Ascians to attend to, among other things.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000960_ALISAIE
106.description: Forgive me, but I count <hex:021A020203>six<hex:021A020103> vessels. And there are only five of us.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000970_MYSTERYVOICE
107.description: One is for testing purposes. I will personally use it to see whether the crystal functions as it should.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_000980_ALISAIE
108.description: And...if it does, wouldn't that mean that your soul could also return to the Source?

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001000_MYSTERYVOICE
110.description: But there is a distinct difference between your circumstances and mine. While your corporeal forms want for souls, my past self does not.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001010_MYSTERYVOICE
111.description: Mayhap our essences would blend. Or mayhap they would curdle. There is no telling what might occur.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001020_ALISAIE
112.description: And you'd be willing to take that risk?

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001050_ELIDIBUS
115.description: Excellent. I had intended to speak with you alone.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001060_ELIDIBUS
116.description: None of my doing, lest you misunderstand. The link between her body and soul wavers.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001070_ELIDIBUS
117.description: I know not what you hoped to find here, but it will avail you naught to learn of our past.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001080_LAHABREA
118.description: (-Convocation Speaker-)<hex:024804F2022303>Reviewing the records yet again? Really? You worry too much, Elidibus.<hex:0248020103>

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001090_LAHABREA
119.description: (-Convocation Speaker-)<hex:024804F2022303>This dedication to your duty verges on obsession.<hex:0248020103>

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001100_IGEYORHM
120.description: (-Convocation Member-)<hex:024804F2022303>To think some thought you ill-suited for the role. How wrong they were.<hex:0248020103>

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001110_IGEYORHM
121.description: (-Convocation Member-)<hex:024804F2022303>But come, turn your gaze outside the window, my friend. The rains have ceased, and we have been graced with another beautiful day.<hex:0248020103>

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001120_ELIDIBUS
122.description: It fades. Fades away into oblivion. Does the world no longer have need of me?

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001130_ELIDIBUS
123.description: No. I am Elidibus. And I must─I <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> fulfill my duty.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001140_ELIDIBUS
124.description: Sundered though you may be, you fought for the world's salvation. For hope.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001160_ELIDIBUS
126.description: Ahhh, it swells within me. Empowers me. Now─<hex:021A020203>now<hex:021A020103> I may carry out my mission.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001180_ELIDIBUS
128.description: Why do I yearn for this? Why do I struggle so?

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001190_ELIDIBUS
129.description: I shall take her into my safekeeping. If you want her back, you will do as I ask.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001200_ELIDIBUS
130.description: Show me your strength. I would take your measure.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001210_ELIDIBUS
131.description: I have prepared a suitable arena. You need but ride the flow of aether.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001220_ELIDIBUS
132.description: You have grown stronger since last we fought.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001230_ELIDIBUS
133.description: The result of your trials in the First, no doubt.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001250_YSHTOLA
135.description: My apologies. I freed myself as soon as I awoke, but rather too late, I see.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001260_YSHTOLA
136.description: Now, Elidibus, if you have ceased trading blows, I would trade words with you.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001270_YSHTOLA
137.description: I have a theory, you see─one concerning that which you seek to accomplish.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001280_YSHTOLA
138.description: It stems from who─or rather <hex:021A020203>what<hex:021A020103>─you truly are: a primal.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001290_YSHTOLA
139.description: The ancients created Zodiark to deliver the star from destruction.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001300_YSHTOLA
140.description: If the magick that brought Him forth is the precursor of what we know as summoning, then Zodiark would have been instilled with a presiding desire...

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001310_YSHTOLA
141.description: I found it among the records at Anyder. And it came as no surprise. Were I faced with the world's destruction, I too would wish for the same...

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001330_YSHTOLA
143.description: I know that you sacrificed yourself to become Zodiark's heart.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001340_YSHTOLA
144.description: How you came to be separated from Him is less clear...

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001350_YSHTOLA
145.description: But if you are a fragment of His being, it stands to reason a desire for the world's salvation would drive you.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001360_YSHTOLA
146.description: And thus did you seek to inspire the masses to rise up as Warriors of Light, going so far as to use Ardbert as a symbol of hope.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001370_ELIDIBUS
147.description: Correct on all counts. Such is my nature, and such are my methods.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001380_ELIDIBUS
148.description: I have aided heroes. I have made them. I have even become them.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001390_ELIDIBUS
149.description: This served not only to strengthen me, but also to facilitate the work of my brothers, such as Emet-Selch, with his penchant for nation building.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001400_YSHTOLA
150.description: Then you will be all too familiar with the fickleness of mankind.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001410_YSHTOLA
151.description: We change. We forget. And what little we do remember becomes twisted and fragmented over time. For which reason, you deem us unfit to carry on your legacy.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001420_YSHTOLA
152.description: But are you yourself free of these foibles? As the last witness of the Final Days, do you remember <hex:021A020203>everything<hex:021A020103> that was lost? Or even the things you cared about?

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001440_YSHTOLA
154.description: A primal is shaped by the hope that fuels it. Even should this hope be something as simple as the world's salvation, it is the collective desire of innumerable disparate souls crying out for deliverance.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001450_YSHTOLA
155.description: Having drawn your strength from such a cacophony of voices, can you truly be sure you still speak with your own?

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001480_ELIDIBUS
158.description: No matter how much I should change, no matter how much I should forget, I shall ever remember my duty.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001490_ELIDIBUS
159.description: At times I stand with my brethren. At times I stand against them. All that I might steer mankind and the very star upon their true course.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001500_ELIDIBUS
160.description: For Elidibus is my name. And my mission. Guiding my every deed.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001510_ELIDIBUS
161.description: But enough talk. You have shown me sufficient proof of your might.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001520_ELIDIBUS
162.description: As I am now, I would struggle to defeat you. Yet I have still to play all of my cards.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001530_ELIDIBUS
163.description: If I could offer you some semblance of sport, your lessers would pose no threat to me. Would you not agree, Warrior of Darkness?

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001540_EMETSELCH
164.description: Gone is the brilliant radiance of life, replaced by the sickly glow of malformed creatures.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001550_EMETSELCH
165.description: Is this to be how it ends? For we who loved the star with all our being?

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001560_EMETSELCH
166.description: No. I will not suffer it to be so.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001570_HYTHLODAEUS
167.description: (-???-)<hex:024804F2022303>Well, well. We meet again, my new old friend.<hex:0248020103>

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
170.description: The, uh...receptionist at the Bureau of the Secretariat?

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001590_HYTHLODAEUS
172.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Chief of the Bureau of the Architect, in fact. Where I also answered to the name of “Hythlodaeus.”<hex:0248020103>

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001600_HYTHLODAEUS
173.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Heh heh... I see you have been collecting stars.<hex:0248020103>

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001610_HYTHLODAEUS
174.description: <hex:024804F2022303>I speak of those crystals. They have constellations etched upon them, yes?<hex:0248020103>

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001620_HYTHLODAEUS
175.description: <hex:024804F2022303>High in the heavens, those stars shine their guiding light down upon the lives below. Fitting symbols for the Convocation of Fourteen, would you not agree?<hex:0248020103>

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001630_HYTHLODAEUS
176.description: <hex:024804F2022303>As you will have gathered, each crystal bears an account of the life of a member of the Convocation as remembered by the unsundered.<hex:0248020103>

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001640_HYTHLODAEUS
177.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Lest you worry, they aren't concepts; they are far too incomplete to be so. But they suffice for imbuing memories within sundered souls, that they might be restored to their office.<hex:0248020103>

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001650_HYTHLODAEUS
178.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Keep them. I am sure Emet-Selch wouldn't mind.<hex:0248020103>

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001660_HYTHLODAEUS
179.description: <hex:024804F2022303>So, how fare you of late? You are feuding with Elidibus this time, I believe?<hex:0248020103>

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001670_HYTHLODAEUS
180.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Hm... I shall refrain from passing comment on your struggle. It is not my place to do so, long-departed as I am.<hex:0248020103>

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001680_HYTHLODAEUS
181.description: <hex:024804F2022303>But if I may give voice to a personal desire...I would rather you lived.<hex:0248020103>

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001690_HYTHLODAEUS
182.description: <hex:024804F2022303>If you do not, how will you keep your promise to Emet-Selch? The promise to remember?<hex:0248020103>

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001700_HYTHLODAEUS
183.description: <hex:024804F2022303>It must weigh heavy, the burden of all those memories.<hex:0248020103>

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001710_HYTHLODAEUS
184.description: <hex:024804F2022303>To one who has lived a life such as yours, I can well imagine how Elidibus's existence might seem hollow─how empty his single-minded pursuit of a half-forgotten cause must appear...<hex:0248020103>

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001720_HYTHLODAEUS
185.description: <hex:024804F2022303>But know that his devotion is not without reason. Even if he himself can no longer remember what that reason is.<hex:0248020103>

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001730_HYTHLODAEUS
186.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Well, that is quite enough talk about Elidibus. I would see if you can reunite the wayward stars.<hex:0248020103>

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001740_HYTHLODAEUS
187.description: <hex:024804F2022303>I mentioned before that there was a member of the Convocation who opposed Zodiark's summoning and defected. One whose office was left vacant...<hex:0248020103>

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001750_HYTHLODAEUS
188.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Defectors having been deemed unworthy of commemoration, no crystal exists for the individual in question.<hex:0248020103>

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001760_HYTHLODAEUS
189.description: <hex:024804F2022303>...Or shouldn't exist, at any rate─and wouldn't, had a friend not created one in secret.<hex:0248020103>

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001770_HYTHLODAEUS
190.description: <hex:024804F2022303>A crystal bearing the forgotten name of <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> office, along with a magick of <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> own conceiving─a singular incantation embodying <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> spirit.<hex:0248020103>

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001780_HYTHLODAEUS
191.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Among all the offices, the Fourteenth was most unusual. For while the rest sat in Amaurot, its holder was charged with gaining an intimate knowledge of the wider world.<hex:0248020103>

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001790_HYTHLODAEUS
192.description: <hex:024804F2022303>In the course of his duty, he traveled the length and breadth of every land, and befriended countless folk.<hex:0248020103>

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001800_HYTHLODAEUS
193.description: <hex:024804F2022303>In the course of her duty, she traveled the length and breadth of every land, and befriended countless folk.<hex:0248020103>

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001810_HYTHLODAEUS
194.description: <hex:024804F2022303><hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> encountered troubles too, of course. Matters which <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> could simply have referred to the Convocation. But that was not <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> way.<hex:0248020103>

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001820_HYTHLODAEUS
195.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Nay, more often than not, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> would call upon <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> comrades, and together resolve matters themselves.<hex:0248020103>

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001830_HYTHLODAEUS
196.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Such is the magick sealed within that crystal─the magick to summon the stars to your side.<hex:0248020103>

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001840_HYTHLODAEUS
197.description: <hex:024804F2022303>In time of greatest need, should you wish upon it with all your heart, it will surely answer your call.<hex:0248020103>

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001850_HYTHLODAEUS
198.description: <hex:024804F2022303>And now it is where it belongs.<hex:0248020103>

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001860_HYTHLODAEUS
199.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Oh, there is no need for thanks. But nor will I hear any complaints about it either.<hex:0248020103>

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001870_HYTHLODAEUS
200.description: <hex:024804F2022303>After all, I cannot say whether I act of my own volition or by the will of my recreator!<hex:0248020103>

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001880_YSHTOLA
201.description: I was wondering where you had disappeared to.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001910_YSHTOLA
204.description: I have everything. Let's hurry back to the surface.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001930_YSHTOLA
206.description: Master Chai, my congratulations on your appointment. By all accounts, you are a capable mayor.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001940_CHAINUZZ
207.description: Oh, I have capable friends, my lady. I must say, it's good to see you looking hale and whole again.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001950_YSHTOLA
208.description: The credit for that lies with my own capable friend, without whom I might never have escaped my abductor.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001960_THANCRED
209.description: A primal... I suppose that would explain why Elidibus has been fostering faith in the Warrior of Light.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001970_THANCRED
210.description: While you were enjoying your audience with the wandering heart of Zodiark, we were busy dispatching the last of the black-masked Ascians. A task which proved almost insultingly easy.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001980_THANCRED
211.description: Formidable though we undoubtedly are, they were obviously sent to provide encouragement for budding heroes. One cannot help but wonder how many times the ploy has been used before...

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_001990_ALPHINAUD
212.description: Master Chai, you mentioned that the people of Kholusia are similarly enamored of the Warrior of Light.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002000_CHAINUZZ
213.description: Indeed. Though it's hardly surprising given the state of the world. Many are still struggling to find a purpose, and it's only natural that they should take comfort in the tales.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002010_ALPHINAUD
214.description: Then the fever has spread to every corner of Norvrandt.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002020_ALPHINAUD
215.description: We may have dealt with his black-masked minions, but it is plain Elidibus has yet to show his hand.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002030_DULIACHAI
216.description: Oh my, what a spectacular sky!

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002080_EULMOREMANA
222.description: Did you hear that? That voice, calling out...

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002090_EULMOREMANB
223.description: No, I didn't hear anything. But...

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002100_EULMOREMANB
224.description: Why do I feel so... Like I've lost something dear to me...

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002110_ALPHINAUD
225.description: Does Elidibus seek to awaken more people to the Echo with clearer visions of the Final Days?

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002120_WARRIOROFLIGHTAVATARS
226.description: In the name...of the Light...I shall vanquish...the Darkness...

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002130_WARRIOROFLIGHTAVATARS
227.description: I shall deliver the world from its doom!

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002160_ALISAIE
230.description: Whoever they are, they've come for our heads!

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002190_YSHTOLA
233.description: They are not of flesh and blood.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002210_URIANGER
235.description: The rings are like unto those that the Exarch did employ in our summoning.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002230_THANCRED
237.description: Are you saying the Exarch is summoning them?

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002240_URIANGER
238.description: Nay. Yet the similarity can be no mere coincidence...

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002260_RYNE
240.description: Should we make a stand here? Or retreat to the Crystarium?

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002270_YSHTOLA
241.description: The aether churns around us. More of them will appear ere long.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002280_YSHTOLA
242.description: To stay would only place innocents in harm's way. We must fight this battle elsewhere.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002300_CHAINUZZ
244.description: Take one of our airships! You can decide what to do on your flight to the Crystarium!

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002310_YSHTOLA
245.description: You are a capable leader in your own right, Master Chai. The citizens of Eulmore chose well.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002320_ALPHINAUD
246.description: It's settled, then. To the airship!

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002330_RYNE
247.description: I think that's the last of them...

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002340_THANCRED
248.description: Apparently, even they have limits. Nevertheless, we should remain vigilant.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002350_ALISAIE
249.description: Urianger, something occurred to me while we were fighting. These enemies...

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002360_URIANGER
250.description: ...Are heroes hailing from other shards, summoned hither to deliver this world from its doom.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002370_URIANGER
251.description: Scant moments after the starshower did they appear─as yet more souls were inspired to walk the hero's path, no doubt.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002380_URIANGER
252.description: Thus did hopes for salvation of realms near and far resonate and converge...lending still greater strength unto our adversary.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002390_ALISAIE
253.description: So that's Elidibus's game. But first things first: if the rings are the same as the Exarch's, then we need to ask him how that's possible.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002400_ALPHINAUD
254.description: The Crystarium is close. Let us press on.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002420_THANCRED
256.description: So near and yet so far.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002430_RYNE
257.description: “In the chaos of conflict, one can always find an opening to exploit.”

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002450_THANCRED
259.description: Whoever taught you that is a wise man indeed. And good with a gunblade. But yes, I daresay we can create an opening wide enough for at least one of us to slip through.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002460_THANCRED
260.description: That being you, of course─though others are welcome to follow in your wake. Ryne and I will keep our guests occupied.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002470_YSHTOLA
261.description: Brave and selfless as ever. Yet the two of you may struggle to fool our foes, aetherically sensitive as they are.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002480_YSHTOLA
262.description: Had you a comrade who could use destructive magicks to wreak havoc upon the ambient aether, on the other hand...

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002500_URIANGER
264.description: Very well, I too shall assist in the diversionary effort.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002510_ALISAIE
265.description: Oh, not this old dance again... Yes. Obviously, I'll stay and fight.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002520_ALISAIE
266.description: Alphinaud! I'm about to do a great many stupid and reckless things. Watch my back, would you?

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002530_ALPHINAUD
267.description: And there you have it. Take care of yourself, my friend.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
269.description: Make it a nice big opening, eh!?

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
270.description: You don't have enough lives for this...

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A5_000_003_NONE_VOICE
271.description: Use your magic sparingly, do you hear?

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002550_YSHTOLA
273.description: Rest assured I have no intention of expending any of mine this day.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002560_ALPHINAUD
274.description: I shall not overexert myself without good reason. As for the others...

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002590_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
277.description: A short while earlier, in the Ocular...

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002610_BEQLUGG
279.description: Let me see! Let me see!

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002620_BEQLUGG
280.description: Yes! Your memories are preserved safely within! We've done it! We've done it at last!

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002640_MYSTERYVOICE
282.description: I have inspected the other vessels. They are all ready to receive of our friends' memories.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002660_BEQLUGG
284.description: I shall have my familiars bear word to them at once!

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002680_ELIDIBUS
286.description: It was not until I observed the battle between Emet-Selch and the Warrior of Darkness that I realized what I must do.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002690_ELIDIBUS
287.description: I will summon heroes from other worlds unto the First, just as you did.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002700_ELIDIBUS
288.description: Their presence shall serve to empower me─granting me the strength to crush my enemy.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002710_MYSTERYVOICE
289.description: Though it pains me to disappoint you, I feel compelled to explain that the magick in question requires no small amount of preparation.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002720_ELIDIBUS
290.description: Ah, but you assume I require my champions to be summoned in their entirety. I do not. Their souls needn't even be whole.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002730_ELIDIBUS
291.description: My purpose requires no more than their burning desire to vanquish evil.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002740_ELIDIBUS
292.description: This I shall sear upon the aether, raising thereby an army of phantom heroes, to whom I shall whisper, as I have to so many over the ages...

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002750_ELIDIBUS
293.description: “Here lies darkness. It must be destroyed.”

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002760_MYSTERYVOICE
294.description: And you expect me to cooperate?

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002770_ELIDIBUS
295.description: I do not require your cooperation. Your death will suffice. The magick, I shall have from your corpse.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002840_MYSTERYVOICE
302.description: No matter... Elidibus... He took us unawares...

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002860_BEQLUGG
304.description: It was all we could do...to raise a ward to hinder his steps... And so we fled...

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002870_BEQLUGG
305.description: But he took it... The vessel with the Exarch's memories...

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002890_MYSTERYVOICE
307.description: The vessel bears not only my memories, but my blood─the blood of Allagan royalty...granting him the means to control the tower.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002900_MYSTERYVOICE
308.description: With it, he has performed I know not how many summonings, calling forth heroes from across the rift.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002910_MYSTERYVOICE
309.description: And as you can see, the burden upon the tower is beginning to tell...

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
312.description: I'm just glad you're alive. Make sure you stay that way.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002920_MYSTERYVOICE
313.description: No. I won't let you go alone. Not this time.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002930_MYSTERYVOICE
314.description: If you mean to face him alone, I will not allow it. Not this time.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002950_MYSTERYVOICE
316.description: Elidibus has exploited the people's nobility. Twisted their purest intentions for terrible ends.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002960_MYSTERYVOICE
317.description: And I cannot let it stand. As Exarch, it is my duty to protect them. To defend their hopes and dreams.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002970_MYSTERYVOICE
318.description: So I'm going to the Crystal Tower, with or without your blessing─though I would rather it were with.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_002990_BEQLUGG
320.description: I'd join you...but I would only be a burden. Better that I remain here with my gremlins...

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003000_MYSTERYVOICE
321.description: I shall send help. Stay strong, my friend, and take heart.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003010_MYSTERYVOICE
322.description: By binding Elidibus within the tower, we have done more than simply delay him.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003020_MYSTERYVOICE
323.description: Much like our adversary, I am not wont to show my hand prematurely. But the time has come to bring my strongest card to bear.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003040_MYSTERYVOICE
325.description: Not here either. We must keep climbing.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003080_MYSTERYVOICE
329.description: I cannot keep up with you. Nor will it avail us to make a stand here.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003090_MYSTERYVOICE
330.description: You must go on without me. Find Elidibus, and stop him.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003110_MYSTERYVOICE
332.description: Though I am no warrior, I have learned to hold my own over the years.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003120_MYSTERYVOICE
333.description: When first we explored this tower, you and your fellow adventurers formed the van, while I was left to follow in your wake.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003130_MYSTERYVOICE
334.description: Suffice it to say, I was not best pleased with the arrangement. How I wished that I could join you...

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003140_MYSTERYVOICE
335.description: And now I have, here where it all began.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003150_MYSTERYVOICE
336.description: I was right to trust in you and the power of your legacy─of your name. To let them guide my every deed.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003160_ELIDIBUS
337.description: For Elidibus is my name. And my mission. Guiding my every deed.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
340.description: Did you never consider other paths?

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003170_MYSTERYVOICE
341.description: Why you? Why <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> you? Had I chosen another, we would never have made it this far. Or do I mistake your meaning...?

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003180_MYSTERYVOICE
342.description: I did─but I chose not to walk them, thank the gods. Whyever would you ask me such a thing?

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003190_MYSTERYVOICE
343.description: ...Elidibus spoke in similar terms, you say? How curious.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003200_MYSTERYVOICE
344.description: To answer your question, then, I made my choice for reasons which seemed obvious to me, but may not to any other.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003210_MYSTERYVOICE
345.description: There were the expectations I placed upon myself before beginning my slumber. And the expectations of those who roused me.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003220_MYSTERYVOICE
346.description: Of course, I had the choice to turn my back on the lot of it. But in the end, it was no choice at all.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003230_MYSTERYVOICE
347.description: I cherish the time I spent with you and the others. What I wouldn't give to return to those halcyon days...

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003240_MYSTERYVOICE
348.description: Chasing ancient secrets, overcoming trial after trial with the aid of like-minded comrades...

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003250_MYSTERYVOICE
349.description: And what remarkable comrades they were. In such company, I felt as if I were a character in the epic tales that had stirred my heart as a boy. As if my dream had come true...

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003260_MYSTERYVOICE
350.description: It hadn't, of course, for I was no hero. Neither then nor after. Though the world to which I awakened, and the First were beset with myriad problems, I rarely knew how best to play my part.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003270_MYSTERYVOICE
351.description: There was, however, one thing of which I was certain: that I could not bear to let those dear to me meet a tragic end.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003280_MYSTERYVOICE
352.description: I'm afraid our time is up. Go.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003290_MYSTERYVOICE
353.description: Rest assured you haven't seen the last of me. I wouldn't dream of playing my trump card save in your presence.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003320_ELIDIBUS
356.description: Worthless, all. Worthless as memories of the only past. Fated to fray and fade into oblivion.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003330_ELIDIBUS
357.description: Leaving naught but a gaping void...

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003340_ELIDIBUS
358.description: The Waking...Sands? ...Yes, that was the place. The place I first made myself known to you and yours.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003350_ELIDIBUS
359.description: The seventh Rejoining had left the realm listing dangerously towards Darkness. And events were unfolding that threatened to push it over the brink.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003360_ELIDIBUS
360.description: Thus did I approach you, in my capacity as emissary, thinking that you would make a useful pawn...

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003370_ELIDIBUS
361.description: But I was wrong, and for my misstep did Lahabrea and Emet-Selch pay the ultimate price. Leaving me the last of the unsundered.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003380_ELIDIBUS
362.description: My remaining brethren, fragmented as they are, cannot hope to see our mission to its end. It falls to me alone.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003390_ELIDIBUS
363.description: Defeat is not an option. I will strike you down. I will resurrect Lord Zodiark. And I will bring back those who sacrificed themselves to call Him forth.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003400_ELIDIBUS
364.description: Though it take a thousand thousand years, upon my honor as Elidibus, emissary of the Convocation of Fourteen, I will see this done.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003410_HYTHLODAEUS
365.description: <hex:024804F2022303>But know that his devotion is not without reason. Even if he himself can no longer remember what that reason is.<hex:0248020103>

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003420_LAHABREA
366.description: (-Convocation Speaker-)<hex:024804F2022303>You worry too much, Elidibus. This dedication to your duty verges on obsession.<hex:0248020103>

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A8_000_001_NONE_VOICE
369.description: Those who once relied upon you are no more.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A8_000_002_NONE_VOICE
370.description: However hard you struggle, you will never bring back the Convocation.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003440_ELIDIBUS
371.description: What of it!? I have my mission!

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003450_ELIDIBUS
372.description: I am Elidibus! And it is my duty to steer mankind and the very star upon their true course. This I swore to...to someone.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003460_ELIDIBUS
373.description: We spoke, and I swore...what? What did I...?

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003480_ELIDIBUS
375.description: This pain, this torment...is nothing! No more than must be suffered to deliver the world from its doom! No more than any of you malformed creatures have known!

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003490_ELIDIBUS
376.description: Even should you lose all that is dear to you. Even should it cost you your life...

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003500_DUMMYARDBERT
377.description: Even should you lose all that is dear to you. Even should it cost you your life...

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003510_ELIDIBUS
378.description: You bear the burden and fight on, kicking and screaming until your last breath is spent!

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003520_DUMMYARDBERT
379.description: You bear the burden and fight on, kicking and screaming until your last breath is spent!

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003530_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
380.description: (-Voice from Within-)Aye, it's true. We've lost much and more. Known unimaginable suffering.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003540_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
381.description: (-Voice from Within-)But through it all, we never, ever forgot what was dear to us. And that's what gave us the strength to carry on.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A9_000_001_NONE_VOICE
383.description: You've no fight left to fight.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A9_000_002_NONE_VOICE
384.description: I will put an end to this.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003550_ELIDIBUS
385.description: No! NO! It will not end here!

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003560_ELIDIBUS
386.description: Champions from beyond the rift, heed my call! The time is come to deliver your brethren from darkness!

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003570_ELIDIBUS
387.description: My heart's sole desire is a world free of sorrow. Join with me now in hope and prayer...for the salvation of all!

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003580_ELIDIBUS
388.description: (-Elidibus-)If you would usher in the end, then with my all shall I oppose you...

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003590_ELIDIBUS
389.description: (-Elidibus-)...As the avatar of those mortal heroes who fought unfalteringly, in all their imperfection! As the Warrior of Light incarnate!

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003600_ELIDIBUS
390.description: Come, Warrior of Darkness! Let us finish this!

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003620_EMETSELCH
392.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Herein I commit the chronicle of the traveler. Shepherd to the stars in the dark.<hex:0248020103>

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003630_EMETSELCH
393.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Though the world be sundered and our souls set adrift, where you walk, my dearest friend, fate shall surely follow.<hex:0248020103>

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003640_EMETSELCH
394.description: <hex:024804F2022303>For yours is the Fourteenth seat─the seat of Azem.<hex:0248020103>

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003650_ELIDIBUS
395.description: An invocation of eld...though not of Hydaelyn's making... What are you?

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003660_ELIDIBUS
396.description: No─it matters not! You are the enemy, and you will fall! Even should it cost me everything, I will not forsake my duty!

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003670_ELIDIBUS
397.description: Fool! You have achieved nothing! I am immortal, and I will never surrender!

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003690_MYSTERYVOICE
399.description: Elidibus. So fixated were you on my memories of the future, you failed to heed the lessons of the past.

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003700_MYSTERYVOICE
400.description: Your obsession blinded you to the true nature of this tower─this beacon of hope for mankind.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003710_MYSTERYVOICE
401.description: Created to serve as a reservoir for the limitless energy of the heavens! To harness and bind the boundless─not unlike white auracite!

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003720_MYSTERYVOICE
402.description: Your ill-begotten power, obtained by exploiting that which is best in us... I shall have it, your soul and all!

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003750_ELIDIBUS
405.description: Yes... I would become Him. I would save everyone. This I believed. Yet still they cried out, in rage and despair...

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003760_ELIDIBUS
406.description: Divided─over the fate of the star. A rare occurrence, always fleeting. But not this time. Not this time...

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003770_ELIDIBUS
407.description: Reconciliation. Elidibus. I was needed. I withdrew myself from Zodiark. For them...

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003790_ELIDIBUS
409.description: Stay strong. Keep the faith. At duty's end, we will meet again. We will. We will.

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003800_ELIDIBUS
410.description: The rains have ceased, and we have been graced with another beautiful day. But you are not here to see it.

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003810_MYSTERYVOICE
411.description: I concede, I may have overexerted myself.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003820_MYSTERYVOICE
412.description: Steady now, and listen. I told you before that I had a plan, and that when all was said and done, I would ask a favor of you.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003830_MYSTERYVOICE
413.description: We have averted the Eighth Umbral Calamity. Found a way for everyone to return to the Source, and...last but not least, we have secured the future of all the people of Norvrandt. We have won, my friend.

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003840_MYSTERYVOICE
414.description: So I hope you'll forgive me this moment of selfishness. And...while I wouldn't want you to feel obliged...

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003850_MYSTERYVOICE
415.description: Promise me you'll take me on your next adventure. A journey. Together. That's all I ask.

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003870_MYSTERYVOICE
420.description: If I were to tell you that this isn't the end─that we will meet again─would you believe me?

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003890_MYSTERYVOICE
422.description: My friend. With you, my mind and memories shall travel to the ends of the world and beyond. But in this place shall my body stand immovable.

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003900_MYSTERYVOICE
423.description: May it serve as an undying promise, not only to those who looked to me for leadership, but to any soul who has known despair, that hope is everlasting.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003910_RYNE
424.description: There the Exarch would remain, keeping his silent vigil.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003920_RYNE
425.description: When the Scions were not released from his summoning spell, we proceeded with the plan to return them to the Source.

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003930_RYNE
426.description: The Warrior of Darkness, however, retained <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> ability to traverse the two worlds at will.

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003940_RYNE
427.description: And in time the Crystal Tower became a symbol of his link to the First─and of hope.

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003950_RYNE
428.description: And in time the Crystal Tower became a symbol of her link to the First─and of hope.

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003970_ALPHINAUD
430.description: Please, Lady Chai, dry your eyes!

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_003980_DULIACHAI
431.description: The thought of never seeing you again... It's more than my poor heart can bear!

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004000_CHAINUZZ
433.description: Oh, it's you. As you can see, Alphinaud has broken the news.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004010_CHAINUZZ
434.description: I don't know how to console her. She thinks we'll be lost without him.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A11_000_002_NONE_VOICE
437.description: Make sure you leave nothing unsaid.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A11_000_003_NONE_VOICE
438.description: A picture paints a thousand words!

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004020_ALPHINAUD
439.description: 'Tis more than I deserve. Yet I am truly grateful, and will see that she knows as much.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004040_ALPHINAUD
441.description: You'll never let me forget it, will you. I'll have you know I completed the promised painting in the end. Be that as it may, there are times only words will suffice.

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004050_ALPHINAUD
442.description: Lady Chai, I have a confession to make.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004060_ALPHINAUD
443.description: On the day we ousted Lord Vauthry, when I revealed the truth of his tyranny and your complicity in his crimes, I did so with great trepidation. Not out of fear that you wouldn't listen, but that you might never recover.

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004070_ALPHINAUD
444.description: There was a time when I too, in my hubris, believed myself worthy to lord it over others. And when the lie was laid bare─when I was forced to confront the cost, the lives lost─it all but destroyed me.

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004080_ALPHINAUD
445.description: To awaken from a naive dream to so harsh a reality... I would have understood had you all surrendered to despair.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004090_ALPHINAUD
446.description: But you didn't surrender. Far from it. You picked yourselves up and rose to the challenge.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004100_ALPHINAUD
447.description: You found a path forward and the strength to walk it─and to keep walking it─day after day.

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004110_ALPHINAUD
448.description: But what struck me is how much faster you found it than I did.

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004120_CHAINUZZ
449.description: ...Really? It felt pretty slow to me! But rest assured, we'll make Eulmore into a nation anyone would be proud to call home...eventually.

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004130_CHAINUZZ
450.description: You can still come and go as you please, I believe? When we have good tidings to report, I may trouble you to be their bearer.

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004140_CHAINUZZ
451.description: There may also be less-than-good tidings...in which event, I hope I can trouble you for your counsel.

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004150_ALPHINAUD
452.description: I should be honored to provide it, Master Chai.

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004160_DULIACHAI
453.description: Oh, Alphinaud... I know you aren't one to sit still, but do remember to take your ease from time to time.

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004170_DULIACHAI
454.description: And no matter where you are, remember that there are people here who are praying for your health and happiness.

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004180_DULIACHAI
455.description: Our brave and gentle artist. You have our love, now and always.

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004190_ALPHINAUD
456.description: And you mine. Please take care.

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004210_SETO
458.description: So it is. It has changed...but I would know it anywhere. However did you come by it?

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004220_SETO
459.description: ...Then even in death, his enemies found a way to profit from his sacrifice. It grieves me to think of his body being used for evil ends...

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004230_SETO
460.description: But thanks to you, his honor is restored, and he may finally find peace.

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004240_SETO
461.description: No words can express my gratitude. I will keep this crystal safe to the end of my days.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004250_SETO
462.description: Rest easy, my friend. You have earned it.

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_A12_000_001_NONE_VOICE
464.description: Tell me, does anything strike you as different about my soul?

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004290_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
469.description: Seto, my old friend. You've grown!

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004300_SETO
470.description: Oh! Oh, Ardbert! How I've missed you!

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004310_SETO
471.description: I'm sorry I couldn't keep you safe... Or even console you.

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004320_SETO
472.description: Had I only learned to speak sooner, I would have told you how much you meant to me. How much I cared.

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004340_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
474.description: But I'm happy to hear it nonetheless. Thank you, Seto. My partner in crime.

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004360_SETO
476.description: Then I will not yet bid him rest. With you, he may look forward to many more adventures.

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004370_SETO
477.description: It has been a while since last I flew. Perhaps I too will go on a little adventure. Ride the winds, seek the horizon... Yes. I think perhaps I will.

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004390_RUNAR
479.description: For too long, I have remained silent. But no longer. I could not bear it if you were to leave. Please stay! I beg of you!

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004410_RUNAR
481.description: ...I jest. At least in part. Ahem. What I came to say is this...

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004420_RUNAR
482.description: Thank you. Without your wisdom, your strength, and your kindness to guide us, our people would still be lost.

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004430_RUNAR
483.description: We will never forget you, Master Matoya. Wherever your journeys may take you, you will always be in our hearts.

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004450_YSHTOLA
486.description: Remember that your people's journey─that <hex:021A020203>our<hex:021A020103> people's journey is yet ongoing. Your lives will change, and so too will your dreams. Yet come what may, you need not forsake your time-honored traditions, nor less your beliefs.

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004460_YSHTOLA
487.description: But neither should you be beholden to them. For it was with curiosity and courage that the Night's Blessed first triumphed over adversity. New knowledge and new wisdom are ever worthy of pursuit.

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004470_RUNAR
488.description: Indeed they are. And so, until we return to the sunless sea, we shall endeavor to live our lives to the fullest.

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004480_YSHTOLA
489.description: That is well. But however great your strides, there may yet come a day when the challenges you face cannot be surmounted alone.

494.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004520_YSHTOLA
494.description: Since a means to travel between worlds exists, you can be sure I will find a way to employ it.

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004530_YSHTOLA
495.description: And there remain so many mysteries here that want for solving.

498.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004560_ALISAIE
498.description: That's everyone, then. We've all said what we needed to.

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004570_URIANGER
499.description: Even as we speak, Beq Lugg undertaketh their final inspection of our spirit vessels.

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004580_URIANGER
500.description: When thine own preparations for the journey are complete, thou art to present thyself in the Ocular.

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004600_RYNE
502.description: I want to thank you all. On behalf of the First.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004610_RYNE
503.description: You, and Minfilia, and the Exarch.

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004620_RYNE
504.description: Without each and every one of you guiding us, fighting for us...we wouldn't be standing here now. There wouldn't even <hex:021A020203>be<hex:021A020103> a here. And no words can express our gratitude.

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004630_RYNE
505.description: We still have a lot to do, countless trials to overcome─but if it ever seems too much, I'll think of our time together.

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004640_RYNE
506.description: The happy moments...and the sad─I will remember it all. And it will give me the strength to carry on without you.

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004650_RYNE
507.description: Because you made me who I am. Minfilia. Ryne.

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004660_RYNE
508.description: To honor these names and these memories, I will stand with all the people of this land, and strive for a better tomorrow.

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004670_URIANGER
509.description: Thancred. I believe the honor of responding should rightfully be thine.

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004690_THANCRED
511.description: I know better than most how much you've grown, and I have every confidence you'll make your people proud.

512.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004700_THANCRED
512.description: Gods know, I'm proud of you. I always will be. You deserve all the happiness in the world and more.

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004720_LYNA
514.description: (-???-)Might we also say a few words?

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004730_ALPHINAUD
515.description: Why, this is...just about all of you!

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004740_LYNA
516.description: To see you off seemed the least we could do.

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004750_LYNA
517.description: You risked your all for us─fought for a realm not your own. Before you came, we had never known the beauty of the night sky.

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004760_LYNA
518.description: Or the joy of your company.

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004770_LYNA
519.description: Though it saddens us deeply to bid you farewell, it has ever been our way to send off friends with a smile.

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004780_LYNA
520.description: Wherever your road should lead, we shall pray for your safety. And following your brave example, we shall continue to fight for the Crystarium.

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004790_ALISAIE
521.description: With or without us, you've always taken good care of this city. I don't doubt for a moment you'll continue to do so.

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004800_ALPHINAUD
522.description: Aye, a more resilient people we have never known.

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004810_ALPHINAUD
523.description: As resilient and enduring as the tower that watches over you.

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004820_LYNA
524.description: To the last, we did not question the Exarch about his past. It is only now, when he can no longer tell us, that we believe we know the answer.

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004830_LYNA
525.description: We have heard what became of him, and what is about to be attempted.

526.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004840_LYNA
526.description: All will be well, of this we are certain.

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004850_LYNA
527.description: How could it be otherwise, when every soul in the Crystarium is praying for it with all their heart?

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004860_LYNA
528.description: And so, when our lord awakens, I bid you give him a message.

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004870_LYNA
529.description: Tell him he needn't worry about us.

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004880_LYNA
530.description: That he need no longer hide who he truly is. That he should live his own life to the fullest.

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004890_LYNA
531.description: And that if he should ever find himself reminiscing on the past with a smile, we shall be smiling with him.

536.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004910_LYNA
536.description: Thank you. Please look after him for us.

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004930_YSHTOLA
538.description: I daresay we have all the good wishes we can carry. Let us be on our way.

539.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004940_BEQLUGG
539.description: All right, then. Pray proceed as instructed, beginning with your memories.

540.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004950_URIANGER
540.description: The first step is complete. And all appeareth to be in order.

541.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004960_ALISAIE
541.description: Well, that just leaves our souls, then.

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004980_BEQLUGG
543.description: It is done! The vessels have received of both their memories and their souls!

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_004990_BEQLUGG
544.description: I hereby entrust them to your care. They belong to you now. Just be sure to guard them well, yes?

546.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005010_BEQLUGG
546.description: Our theories have held thus far.

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005020_BEQLUGG
547.description: But I make no promises about what is to come. Even the greatest mages in history knew better than to transport a soul across the rift. We, my dear, are in unknown territory.

548.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005030_BEQLUGG
548.description: Prepare as we might, we cannot account for all possibilities, and it is in such circumstances that accidents are wont to occur...

549.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005040_BEQLUGG
549.description: Yet miracles do happen. So let us pray, and will our friends home.

550.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005050_RYNE
550.description: I won't stop praying until I know they're safe.

551.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005060_BEQLUGG
551.description: All safely stowed away? I do hope so.

552.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005070_BEQLUGG
552.description: All that remains, then, is to step into the mirror. Go now...and safe travels.

555.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005100_TATARU
555.description: Oh! Oh, you're back! You're back! You're all back!

557.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005120_YSHTOLA
557.description: Thank you. My body feels like a sack of popotoes, but otherwise I have never felt better.

558.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005130_YSHTOLA
558.description: That said, I doubt any of us will be fit to travel for some while. May we leave the rest to you?

559.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005140_URIANGER
559.description: The vessel beareth our comrade's blood. With it in thy possession, the way will surely open before thee.

560.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005150_TATARU
560.description: What!? But you've only just got here!

562.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005170_ALPHINAUD
562.description: Tataru, might I trouble you to brew us all a pot of your special tea?

563.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005180_ALPHINAUD
563.description: Ah! And we may require an extra cup.

564.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005190_MYSTERYVOICE
564.description: Yours is a long road, my friend, and it stretches on to places beyond imagining.

565.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005200_MYSTERYVOICE
565.description: With your every step, these grand adventures shall grow more distant and faint.

566.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005210_MYSTERYVOICE
566.description: And there may come a day when you forget the faces and voices of those you have met along the way.

567.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005220_MYSTERYVOICE
567.description: On that day, I bid you remember this...

568.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005230_MYSTERYVOICE
568.description: That no matter how far your journey may take you, you stand where you stand by virtue of the road you walked to get there.

569.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005240_MYSTERYVOICE
569.description: For in times of hardship, when you fear you cannot go on...

570.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005250_MYSTERYVOICE
570.description: The joy you have known, the pain you have felt, the prayers you have whispered and answered─they shall ever be your strength and your comfort.

571.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005260_MYSTERYVOICE
571.description: This I hope─I believe, here at memory's end.

574.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005290_ALPHINAUD
574.description: What is it, Alisaie? Are you all right? Do you still feel under the weather?

575.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005300_ALISAIE
575.description: Physically, I couldn't be better. Thanks to Krile's ministrations, I'm already looking forward to our next fight.

576.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005310_ALISAIE
576.description: But seriously─don't you have anything to say about <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103>?

577.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005320_YSHTOLA
577.description: No less impressive than our garments. You've outdone yourself, Tataru.

578.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005330_TATARU
578.description: To give credit where it's due, I had help from a certain fiery pixie who visited me in my dreams. They gave me all the information I needed to get the details just right.

579.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005340_TATARU
579.description: For your weapons, though, I needed a <hex:021A020203>lot<hex:021A020103> more help... Thankfully, our favorite heads of state were happy to place their finest craftsmen at my exclusive disposal.

580.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005350_TATARU
580.description: Oh, and speaking of the Alliance leaders, they all express their “unreserved elation at your safe return,” and promise to come and see you in person as soon as they can.

581.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005360_THANCRED
581.description: They really needn't have gone to such trouble─but we'll be keeping these gifts all the same. Do pass on our gratitude.

582.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005370_ALISAIE
582.description: I realize we haven't taken up new martial arts, nor have I ever been one to set much store by appearances...

583.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005380_ALISAIE
583.description: But I can't help feeling a certain lack of...I don't know, personal development.

585.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005400_ALPHINAUD
585.description: I quite understand. But as you observed, the others had the more pressing need. Rest assured, our turn will come.

586.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005410_KRILE
586.description: If I expend any more aether, I swear I will blink out of existence. I need a bite to eat.

587.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005420_KRILE
587.description: Tataru, a cup of tea, if you would be so kind. And something sweet.

588.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005430_URIANGER
588.description: By Mistress Krile's exhausted state, may I assume that the ward hath been restored?

589.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005440_GRAHATIA
589.description: (-???-)Indeed. We succeeded in weaving it anew, albeit at a slightly diminished potency than when I had Beq Lugg's assistance.

590.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005450_GRAHATIA
590.description: (-???-)It is no cause for concern, though. The tower is not easily reached, never mind breached. And even should some few succeed, their presence won't escape my notice.

591.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005460_URIANGER
591.description: Excellent. Said duty thus discharged, thou art free to go wheresoever thy fancy taketh thee.

592.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005470_URIANGER
592.description: Upon which note─hast thou perchance come to a decision? The offer remaineth open.

593.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005480_GRAHATIA
593.description: (-???-)Well...if you're certain that's what you... I-I mean, if you think I...

600.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005520_GRAHATIA
600.description: I accept. Henceforth, I shall count myself a Scion of the Seventh Dawn.

602.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005540_GRAHATIA
602.description: When I was a boy, many long years ago, I yearned to stand tall as the heroes of eld.

604.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005560_UNSETTLEDRESEARCHER
604.description: Hippogryphs! Hippogryphs on the rampage! A giant flock of 'em! Please, we need help!

605.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005570_ALISAIE
605.description: I could do with a little rampage myself.

608.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005600_GRAHATIA
608.description: But like a fool seeking to pluck the stars from the heavens, my every attempt to reprise their deeds fell short...

609.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005610_YSHTOLA
609.description: I will join the fray when I've finished my tea.

610.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005620_URIANGER
610.description: Thus did the avatar of destruction descend, and in her wake leave naught but tears and ash...

611.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005630_GRAHATIA
611.description: And then, one day, an all but forgotten dream from my youth stood before me, in the flesh.

612.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005640_GRAHATIA
612.description: So it was that a new adventure began...

614.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005660_ZENOS
614.description: The memory of a dying world's end, night after night... And I thought it but a tired old dream.

615.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005670_FANDANIEL
615.description: I say... I knew that securing the palace would provide Your Radiance with depressingly little sport─but that you should fall asleep out of boredom!?

616.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005680_FANDANIEL
616.description: Splendid! Truly splendid! And my own preparations, you will be pleased to hear, proceed apace.

617.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005690_FANDANIEL
617.description: Oh yes, they proceed very well indeed. Frighteningly so. And we owe it not least of all to this singularly useful body I chanced to find.

618.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005700_FANDANIEL
618.description: With the Populares now all but destroyed, it will be the simplest of tasks to discredit their groundless assertions that I met with a grisly end.

619.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005710_FANDANIEL
619.description: And as the very-much-alive lord of House Brutus, I have a vast fortune at my disposal.

620.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005720_FANDANIEL
620.description: Ahhh, money, money, money! The great motivator! There is simply no better way to move men─and expedite plans─than with its alluring glint, would you not agree?

621.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005730_FANDANIEL
621.description: But wait...! Were we not acquainted, you and...“I”?

622.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005740_FANDANIEL
622.description: (-White-robed Figure-)Should our familiarity cause you distress, I beg your forgiveness.

623.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005750_ZENOS
623.description: ...What did you say your name was?

624.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005760_FANDANIEL
624.description: (-White-robed Figure-)Ahhh, a dagger through my heart! That my deepest desire should forever remain unfulfilled! To live unrecognized! To die forgotten!

625.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005770_FANDANIEL
625.description: (-White-robed Figure-)So it goes. Whatever this flesh may have been before, it serves only as a vessel now.

626.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005780_FANDANIEL
626.description: And I, faithful Fandaniel, labor only to advance my lord's ambitions.

627.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005790_FANDANIEL
627.description: Speaking of which, with the palace in our hands, we may now proceed with the next phase of the plan.

628.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005800_FANDANIEL
628.description: But how very odd... Despite all our havoc wreaking, old Elidibus did not deign to appear. Dare I hope...?

629.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005810_FANDANIEL
629.description: That the last of the unsundered...is gone?

631.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005830_FANDANIEL
631.description: Imagine it! Bound no more by the shackles of moldering memories─of damnable duty! Free at last to live for the moment!

632.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005840_FANDANIEL
632.description: Your Radiance. But give the word, and I shall go forth and prepare for you your hunting ground.

633.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005850_GRAHATIA
633.description: That which awaited was a fell beast.

636.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005880_ZENOS
636.description: It has been too, too long, my friend...and insufferably dull in your absence.

637.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005890_ZENOS
637.description: When you return to me, you will share everything. Every blow will be a story unto itself. Every triumph. Every kill.

638.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005900_ZENOS
638.description: Rest assured we shall have a fitting stage for our reunion.

639.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005910_ZENOS
639.description: Oh, yes. To reprise that transcendent moment, I will set this world ablaze. And we shall dance before the pyre.

640.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005920_GRAHATIA
640.description: The beast shall kindle the flames of the apocalypse.

641.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05300_005930_GRAHATIA
641.description: Into its domain shall the hero set forth, for the final chapter in the tale of this star.
